title: 全栈AI与ML工程实验室
summary: 一个涵盖Python、统计、NumPy、Pandas、Matplotlib、机器学习、深度学习、计算机视觉、NLP、LangChain、LangGraph及生成式AI（RAG、LLM、嵌入、智能体）的全栈AI与ML工程实验室，包含FastAPI和动手项目。
summary_en: A full-stack AI & ML engineering lab covering Python, Statistics, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, NLP, LangChain, LangGraph, and Generative AI (RAG, LLMs, Embeddings, Agents). Includes FastAPI and hands-on projects.
